verdict.rationale: Keycloak's own docs say realms can be imported and exported as JSON files, and authorization configuration can also be exported. The Admin REST API, the kcadm.sh CLI and built-in SCIM endpoints give further programmatic ways to pull users and configuration out in standard formats. But the evidence is a single-line mention of realm export, so it is unproven that 'all data' (for example users and credentials) is included in the export. missing for 10: explicit documentation that realm export covers users, credentials, sessions and events, a documented step-by-step migration-out path, and independent hands-on corroboration of a full export and exit.
